messages:
Aman: Heads-up: small but consistent latency spike on pp-cluster-22 during the 2000r/s chat test, microbatch=8 timeline shows ~12-18% tail latency regression.
Lucy: saw that too. looks like bubbles are longer, not pure network noise.
Devin: any recent kernel or kernel-selection changes on that hostpool?
InfraBot: Deploy 1995550000 by lucy/kern-opt completed on pp-cluster-22 at +0s :rocket:
Aman: infra bot shows deploy concurrently with ramp. Could be kernel fallback path triggered (float->int8 dispatch).
Jamal: attaching a brief perf sample from yesterday (reproduced locally):
```
# timeline sample (ms)
step 1 forward: compute 1.1 | allreduce 4.2 | idle 3.0
step 2 forward: compute 1.0 | allreduce 4.5 | idle 2.8
backward: compute 2.8 | allreduce 5.1 | idle 1.5
kvcache lookup: avg 0.45ms, tail 3.6ms (burst when microbatch>4)
```
Lucy: those allreduce times look high vs baseline. packing changed to 256 bytes per tensor after the kernel change?
Devin: yes, kernel-selector switched to 'safe' packer for mixed shapes. It increases small-allreduce overhead.
Tara: microbatch 8 -> increases parallelism but also increases prefix reuse pressure on kvcache, causing eviction storms which spike tail lookups.
Aman: interesting point. So two orthogonal effects: (1) kernel routing caused smaller, more frequent allreduces; (2) larger microbatching raised KV cache churn.
Jamal: quick experiment idea: try microbatch=4 with aggressive allreduce fusion and kvcache.prefetch=16. That should shrink bubble and reduce kv tail.
Devin: I can flip kvcache.prefetch and force the new packer to 'coalesce' mode for a test. command: `redwoodctl set runtime.kvcache.prefetch=16 runtime.allreduce.packer=coalesce`
Lucy: ran that on a canary pod (pp-canary-07). Early numbers: tail latency down 8%, allreduce median down 30%.
Aman: can you paste profiler output for canary?
Lucy: paste:
```
# canary-07 sample
step fwd: compute 1.05 | allreduce 2.9 | idle 0.6
step bwd: compute 2.6  | allreduce 3.2 | idle 0.9
kvcache lookup: avg 0.38ms, tail 0.9ms
overall tail -9% vs baseline
```
Devin: promising. But we need to confirm no quality regressions with coalesce packer (numerical diff check).
Tara: also watch memory pressure: smaller prefetch can increase NVMe spill frequency on older hosts.
Jamal: Suggested action list: 1) run packer coalesce + prefetch=16 on 10% canary for 2h; 2) add 1F1B microbatch sweep: {1,2,4,8} with same load; 3) capture KV cache metrics + eviction traces.
Aman: +1. Add regression eval job for generation quality. If coalesce passes and no spill, promote to cluster-22.
Devin: I'll set up the canary job now and wire in the perf tracer (command below).
```
perf-trace --target pp-canary-07 --duration 2h --metrics allreduce,kv_cache,latency --out /tmp/trace.json
```
Lucy: tagging @Jamal for kv eviction viz and @Tara for spill watchers. :mag:
Jamal: on it. I'll add a small dashboard panel showing eviction spikes aligned to microbatch changes.
Tara: will monitor NVMe and OOMs.
Aman: thanks all — we converged on a hypothesis and a canary plan. Post results in this thread.
Lucy: will post initial 30m summary at 1995550060. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
